malik.title: Day 2/30: The Old Man Laughed. Then He Stopped. How Does He Pay? 👇 #shorts
malik.description:
Day 2/30 of Fight For Mama.
You voted A: Malik pushed open the door of Old Sal's wrestling gym. Everybody laughed at the fish boy... until he lifted the 100 lb sandbag like a crate of fish. Then Ray, his best friend, wants him to sign up for the Brickport Open.

But Sal's lessons aren't free, and Malik has $23.

🗳️ YOU decide: comment A or B!
A) He cleans the gym every night
B) He brings Sal a crate of fresh fish every morning

The most voted choice becomes tomorrow's episode.

Fictional story.
